name: ProGroCo | Red Runtz
description:
Lineage: Red Pop x Runtz

Type: Indica

Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Humulene

Aroma: Dank, Citrus, Berry, Vegetal 

Effects: Blissful, Relaxed, Stress Free

Red Runtz is a Red Pop x Runtz, selected by Pro Gro, with quick heady effects and a strong euphoria consumers are provided with a baseline flavor of sweet, dank undertones that complement a relaxing and creative immersion. This strain fires up the imagination, possibly having you explore a bit more of your artistic side - Enjoy!
